msg.payload={status:'success',data:global.get('lastSensor') || {suhu:null,kelembaban:null,timestamp:null},server_time:new Date().toISOString()}; return msg;

func:
if(msg.req.headers['x-api-key'] !== ('iot-rizky-2026')) {msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={status:'error',message:'API key tidak valid'};return msg;}
const t=Number(msg.payload && msg.payload.temperature); if(!Number.isFinite(t)||t < -40||t>125){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={status:'error',message:'temperature harus angka antara -40 sampai 125'};return msg;} global.set('temperatureThreshold',t); const w=global.get('iotWsServer'); if(w)w.clients.forEach(c=>{if(c.readyState===1)c.send(JSON.stringify({type:'threshold',temperature:t}));}); msg.payload={status:'success',temperature:t}; return msg;

name: get_threshold
func: if(msg.req.headers['x-api-key'] !== ('iot-rizky-2026')) {msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={status:'error',message:'API key tidak valid'};return msg;} let t=Number(global.get('temperatureThreshold')); if(!Number.isFinite(t))t=30; msg.payload={status:'success',temperature:t}; return msg;

name: CORS headers
